title: Design: A/R Summary sorted by Location matches the design picture
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column and the Location chip show, as in the design picture.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with open invoices at both locations on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Open the design picture "Summaries show "Multiple"" (ar-ap-p4-summaries-show-multiple.png) (attached to this case) beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Location" header.
  2. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The rows sort by Location, A to Z, as in the picture: "Location" carries the small up arrow and "Customer" none.
  • The rows reading "Multiple" come first, customer A among them, then each location's rows.

Step 2:

  • Nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.
  • The layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S6-R4: “On A/R Summary and A/P Summary a row shows the location's name when all of that customer's or vendor's open documents at the chosen locations are at one location, otherwise "Multiple".”
  • S6-R5: “The column sorts A to Z on its first click; "Multiple" sorts as text.”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
